Usage: memoriahub deploy status [options]

Report whether the deployment on this server is healthy

Options:
  --root <path>       Deployment directory (rank 1: an explicit path)
  --apps-root <path>  Directory holding the deployments (rank 3 walks up inside
                      it) (default: "/opt/infra/apps")
  --name <app>        Which deployment to act on, by name
  --port <port>       Loopback port the proxy forwards to (default: "3535")
  --domain <domain>   Public domain; adds an external HTTPS check
  --json              Print a machine-readable report on stdout
  --no-color          Disable colour even on a terminal
  -h, --help          display help for command

Examples:
  memoriahub deploy status
  memoriahub deploy status --domain app.example.com
  memoriahub deploy status --json || alert 'deployment unhealthy'

Exit codes:
  0  serving, and the schema is current
  1  installed but unhealthy
  2  nothing is installed at --root

Note that /api/health/ready only proves SELECT 1 succeeded, so it
passes against an empty database. Migration state is reported
separately, and a green probe alone is not treated as proof.
